accepted_principles: Distinguish product from release identities using evidence-bound source-native anchors.
Freeze membership/version/digest and report amendments with before/after denominators.
Keep holdout adjudication labels outside implementer-readable paths, with separate public development cases.
Distinguish directory identities from actual reporting-entity and rate-file bindings.
Record selection before MRF endpoint outcomes are observed.

corrected_or_rejected_examples.issue: A unique publisher/program key can collapse genuinely distinct products within one program.
corrected_or_rejected_examples.required: Use product-level native anchors and explicit evidence for aliases; do not infer identity from program or title similarity.

corrected_or_rejected_examples.issue: A frozen initial cohort cannot already have terminal future execution dispositions.
corrected_or_rejected_examples.required: Freeze all baseline IDs; keep initial not_attempted or explicit eligibility state and record attempts later. Dictionary eligibility needs independent evidence and a versioned denominator, not an inferred fixed reachable set.

corrected_or_rejected_examples.issue: Requiring a retrieved MRF URL/hash for every frozen pilot member contradicts unavailable-member retention and selection before testing.
corrected_or_rejected_examples.required: Require authoritative directory anchors at freeze. Later store a locator/attempt/typed stop reason for every member and successful parsed samples for the actual20/8 thresholds.

corrected_or_rejected_examples.issue: The example requiring every committed task to be public_dev excludes legitimate frozen holdout task metadata.
corrected_or_rejected_examples.required: Protect labels/adjudications and scoring access while retaining stable public task IDs, split metadata and commitments as appropriate.

corrected_or_rejected_examples.issue: Unconditionally add-only membership both changes fixed denominators and disallows explicitly approved, evidenced corrections.
corrected_or_rejected_examples.required: Preserve every prior version; any amendment needs explicit authority, reason, before/after results and evaluation on original membership. Never improve results by removing difficult cases.

corrected_or_rejected_examples.issue: Banning all HTTP receipts at selection also bans authoritative directory evidence needed to select the cohort. Commit timestamp alone does not prove blinding.
corrected_or_rejected_examples.required: Allow directory/documentation captures; distinguish MRF endpoint/sample outcomes, retain an append-only selection commitment before tests, and disclose any known prior outcomes.

handoff_note: Use the task handoff source_identities/artifacts/acceptance_results to bind cohort manifests and future validator inputs. A shared handoff-template change requires PR-003 ownership coordination; missing dedicated key names do not justify modifying shared contracts during PR-002.
acceptance_status: No R01-R16 target or PR-002 implementation is accepted by this review.
